linear-triage.description: Repo-local linear-triage. Far-future cron on purpose; trigger it manually with 'tessl schedule trigger'.

linear-digest.description: Weekly Linear digest: reads recently updated EXP issues and opens a PR adding them to docs/linear-digest.md.

linear-latest-issues.description: Credential pre-flight test: fetches recent Linear issues. Authored via schedule-setup 0.2.0 with the Linear pre-flight installed.

linear-standup.description: Daily Linear standup: reads recent Linear issues and opens a PR updating docs/linear-standup.md.

linear-pulse.description: Daily Linear pulse: reads recent Linear issues and opens a PR updating docs/linear-pulse.md.

notion-digest.description: Weekly Notion digest: reads recently edited pages via the notion MCP server and opens a PR adding them to docs/notion-digest.md.

posthog-digest.description: Weekly PostHog digest: reads recent insights via the posthog MCP server and opens a PR adding them to docs/posthog-digest.md.
